visual_goal: Show discovery as one left-to-right pipeline from the guest query to the property page, with availability joined for every night, a bounded policy setting order, the trip intent store feeding re-priced alerts, and one quote contract giving the same total to every surface.
prompt: A wide left-to-right pipeline drawn as a conveyor of rounded stations. Station one at the far left: a search bar card labeled 'Guest query'. One arrow right to a map-pin station labeled 'Destination graph'. One arrow right to a stack of index cards labeled 'Retrieval'. One arrow right, labeled 'every night', to a calendar station labeled 'Availability join'. One arrow right to a balance-scale station labeled 'Bounded policy'. One arrow right to a screen showing a list, a small map and a row of cards, labeled 'List, map, rails'. One arrow right to a single page with a photo and a table, labeled 'Property page'. Below the screen station, a small filing box labeled 'Trip intent' with one arrow up into the screen station. Above the pipeline, one price tag labeled 'One quote' with two thin dashed arrows down, one into the screen station and one into the property page station.
alt: A pipeline from guest query through destination graph, retrieval, availability join for every night and bounded policy to list, map and rails and the property page, with a trip intent store feeding alerts and one quote giving both surfaces the same total.
